messages.text: Welcome to Pulse Messenger! 🎉 We just launched the core real-time engine.
📌 Mission briefing: Our goal is to conquer WhatsApp and Telegram by building faster sync, pristine UX, zero bloat, and enterprise-grade end-to-end security.
WebSocket low-latency transport is active! Message delivery status tracking is live too.
Hey Alex! Have you reviewed the new dark mode color palette?
Yes! The deep obsidian background and emerald accents look incredible.

📢 **Pulse v1.3 Major Release Briefing**:

• **Clustering Engine**: Horizontal multi-instance sync with Redis & Pub/Sub cluster bus.
• **Telegram-Style Channels**: Broadcast channels with verified handles and read-only feeds.
• **Zero-Knowledge E2EE**: Native Web Crypto ECDH P-256 + AES-GCM-256 with 60-digit safety numbers.
• **WebRTC Calling**: Real-time peer-to-peer audio & video calls with STUN traversal.

Subscribe and react to stay informed! 🚀
